Method of Attack: Clicker app that loads ads in invisible frames or in the background and clicks them to generate revenue
Registers Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) listener to receive push messages with instructions
Visits websites delivered by FCM messages and browses them in the background mimicking user behavior
Uses 'click.cas' component for auto-clicking and 'com.liveposting' agent for hidden adware services
Delays malicious activity start to avoid detection and does not start when user is actively using device
Attack Vector: Google Play Store (official Android app store)
Indicators of Compromise: High battery and mobile data usage without user activity
Network traffic showing HTTP requests for configuration and FCM push messages
